text: The planet is choking on pollution, our oceans are dying, and entire species are vanishing before our eyes. We are standing on the edge of an irreversible ecological catastrophe, and if you're not consumed with rage about it, you're not paying attention. This is an emergency that demands action right now, not calm deliberation.
